packs.name: lead-qualification

packs.name: deal-follow-up
packs.title: Deal follow-up desk
packs.description: Keep commitments, next steps, and draft follow-ups together without sending messages or advancing deals automatically.

packs.name: account-briefs
packs.title: Account meeting briefs
packs.description: Prepare cited account briefs that distinguish known facts, open questions, and proposed meeting goals.

packs.name: employee-onboarding
packs.title: Employee onboarding readiness
packs.description: Track role-based onboarding prerequisites and hand off proposed access requests without provisioning accounts.

packs.name: access-reviews
packs.title: Access review evidence desk
packs.description: Reconcile entitlement evidence and prepare retain-or-revoke recommendations for a human reviewer.

packs.name: incident-triage
packs.title: Incident triage notebook
packs.description: Group observed service failures, assess impact, and prepare a cited incident handoff without changing infrastructure.

packs.name: content-calendar

packs.title: Campaign performance review
packs.description: Normalize campaign observations and explain performance with explicit windows, currencies, and attribution caveats.

packs.name: document-intake

packs.title: Contract renewal watch
packs.description: Extract evidenced renewal obligations and prepare a review queue without making legal or cancellation decisions.

packs.name: invoice-review

packs.description: Classify incoming support cases, expose urgency evidence, and draft an empathetic response for a human.

packs.name: knowledge-gaps
packs.title: Support knowledge gap review
packs.description: Identify recurring unanswered questions and propose evidence-backed documentation improvements without publishing them.

packs.name: issue-triage

packs.description: Prepare evidence-led issue classifications, reproduction gaps, and duplicate candidates for maintainer review.

packs.name: release-readiness
packs.title: Release readiness review
